Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory393.jpg
Lucia
Commandant, we're here.
The transport craft makes a slow descent, touching down at a plaza.
The plaza is nestled between two mountains, with a highway stretching out from it.
This place looks really hidden from a distance.
The plaza was clearly built for Golden Age fighter jets, suggesting that this "Dark Room" was designed with combat in mind.
Lucia starts scanning the area's Punishing Virus concentration after getting off the transport craft.
Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab
Lucia
Commandant, the Punishing density is higher than the data Lee sent back a few days ago.
Looks like Hutu's intel was right.
Lucia
I should look around first.
Pilot
The comms loss is worrying—this looks serious. 【kuroname】, do you need backup?
The transport craft pilot opens the cockpit window and leans out, asking a question.
Thanks.
As usual, call for backup if we don't report in 24 hours.
Pilot
Alright, be careful and keep us posted.
The transport craft takes off slowly, leaving the area.
Ishmael
The entrance looks to be over there.
Ishmael points to a huge door at the base of the mountain ahead of the plaza.
The door is built into the mountainside as if a giant spoon scooped out a chunk of rock. The main "Dark Room" structure is underneath the mountain.
The massive door is firmly closed, separating the inside from the outside.
Ishmael
Doesn't look like anyone's broken in from outside.
Something's definitely off, but don't jump to conclusions yet.
Let's wait and see what Lucia finds.
While you wait, Ishmael asks you a question.
Ishmael
Lee's lost comms, and it's clearly more dangerous than the briefing said...
Ishmael
Why are we turning down the pilot's help?
She sounds curious. Not a loaded question, just a casual, friendly chat—like friends catching up.
Strangely, she starts to feel familiar to you, as if you have known each other for a long time.
Missions like this aren't uncommon to Gray Raven.
Ishmael
Not uncommon...
She repeats the last part softly.
Ishmael
Is this your daily routine now?
Not entirely.
It's only part of it.
Ishmael
I'm really interested in your story.
Unprompted, she says it before getting quiet.
Just as you start to get confused, Lucia comes back from scouting.
Lucia
No signs of anyone breaking in around here. Punishing Virus levels are normal, too.
Ishmael
Internal intrusion...
Internal incursion... That doesn't make sense.
They could've gotten in through other entrances.
Lucia
Other entrances...
There's no way a facility like this only has one entrance.
Ishmael
You're right, 【kuroname】, there'd be other ways in. But those records are gone.
Ishmael
The Control Court only got some of the records. We don't know where the other entrances are.
Ishmael
Hutu probably held back some info to keep himself safe.
So he doesn't fully trust Babylonia...
After searching the area, you find a hidden small door on a far mountainside.
You cannot force the door open, but you find a control panel hidden behind the rocks next to the door after a while.
Since Liv is out and Lee is not here, you have brought a decryption device just in case.
Lucia looks at you after checking the panel.
Lucia
The decryption device needs about 20 minutes...
Ishmael
Do you need my help?
Do you have enough computing power?
You've got a decryption system installed?
Ishmael
Of course.
It would be quicker to have a Construct handle the decryption directly.
Sure.
Thank you.
Ishmael walks up to the panel and skillfully initiates the decryption process.
Ishmael
It'll take about... two minutes.
Ishmael
Hmm... Looks like someone from the base tweaked the system.
(That's some serious computing power...)
Cutting the decryption time by almost ten times—few in the Task Force have that level of power.
Ishmael does not seem worried about revealing some of her cards.
Two minutes later, the door cracks open.
Ishmael
Let's go, 【kuroname】.
Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory83.jpg
Inside, you find a large, open warehouse area with various vehicles.
Lucia
It's weapons and gear... Looks like they're ready to go.
Let's head to the elevator first.
Based on Hutu's data, the underground base has 20 floors total, with B7 to B14 as living areas. They were on B12 at the time.
Ishmael
So, we're going to B12 first?
Right.
Investigating where they spent the most time is the easiest way.
Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory70.jpg
Going through the warehouse, you see the elevator bay ahead of you.
Lucia
Commandant, Hetero-Creatures spotted.
Two medium-sized Hetero-Creatures are wandering near the elevator bay.
Let's go—I'll take the left. You take the right.
Lucia
Roger!
The Hetero-Creatures turn to the three of you, roaring. They have definitely picked up your traces.
(Raise gun and fire at the Hetero-Creature on the left)
BANG—BANG—BANG—
As the fight starts, Lucia immediately speeds up, charging the Hetero-Creature on the right like a fast, low-flying gray raven.
Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryHitNew.prefab
The frost fades as Lucia takes down the Hetero-Creature quickly and cleanly.
At the same time, your bullets hit the left one perfectly, exploding when they hit the Hetero-Creature's torso.
Ishmael
I'm seeing something here...
Ishmael stops at the elevator bay.
One elevator stands out from the others.
The elevator door is ripped open, with a big pool of blood in front. Three bodies lie on the ground, laid out from the elevator.
They're armed—not just regular citizens.
Judging by how they fell, they were trying to get outside.
There are signs that they were attacking backward.
Ishmael
This elevator got trashed, looks like from the inside.
Ishmael
Hmm... They came up in the elevator, and then Hetero-Creatures chased them up the shaft?
Ishmael
This happened... less than an hour ago.
After a quick look at the markings on the floor, Ishmael concludes.
So the Punishing Virus did come from the inside?
Ishmael
Perhaps?
That smile of hers... For a second there, you get the feeling that Ishmael knows exactly what is coming.
Lucia
Commandant, I found this thing on one of them.
What Lucia has found is a Babylonia-made storage device.
Lucia
Lee must've dropped it.
You plug the device into your terminal, and a video starts playing.
Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMidAutumnMessageOpen.prefab
Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab
Lee
Commandant, I'll give you the situation report from here.
Lee
I left this video on a bunch of different paths, making sure you'd find it.
Lee
Following the mission intel, I came to this base to talk to Hutu, their leader, and we had a good exchange.
Lee
But something unexpected happened earlier—a group of Hetero-Creatures showed up inside the base, mainly between B5 and B9.
Lee
Communications are totally down here too.
Lee
We've got way too many evacuees, so I'm helping them pull back to deeper levels, away from the Hetero-Creatures, so...
He pauses for a moment.
Lee
That's why I can't break free alone. I could only leave you a message this way.
Even though he looks worried in the video, Lee keeps his cool and gives a quick rundown of what is happening.
Lee
Right now, we're at B12. Given our speed, we should hit B17 to B19 in about an hour or two, for temporary shelter.
Lee
Then, the stronghold leader's going to leave you a message with some info about the place.
Lee steps to the side, moving out of the frame as a man wearing Kowloong-style clothing walks into view.
Hutu
I'm Hutu, this base's leader. I've been in touch with Babylonia before.
He looks a little anxious.
Hutu
Let's cut to the chase. I'm sending our best team to break out of here and get this video to you guys.
Hutu
If you get this message, I hope you can bring more folks down here with you.
Hutu
This base has its own defense system, which we've tweaked. If things get bad, we can use it to evacuate.
Hutu
But now, something unexpected happened. The defense system kicked in on its own, and we've lost control.
Hutu
The area between B6 and B7 is locked down tight. Nobody's getting out.
Hutu
I'll get my people to go through the ventilation shafts to break through.
Hutu
I hope you see this video... I can't let thousands of people die here.
Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab
Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMidAutumnMessageEnd.prefab
The video cuts off there.
Ishmael
As expected.
What is it?
Ishmael
The "Dark Room" itself has a security system in case of emergencies.
Emergencies?
Ishmael
It's meant to keep people or... something from getting out, I think. Basically, it seals everything off.
Ishmael
The people in this base made use of the Dark Room's defensive system.
Ishmael
They tried to rewrite the system, but they did it poorly. They were trying to use it to defend against the Corrupted, but clearly...
Ishmael
They failed.
Lucia
What should we do next, Commandant?
Leave a message in case we lose contact.
Lee's comms are down. There is probably electromagnetic interference blocking the signals down here.
Hutu said floors B6 and B7 are locked, and Hetero-Creatures are all over B5 through B9, but the vents are pretty safe.
Let's take the elevator to B4 and descend through the vents.
According to Lee's intel, they are supposed to be taking shelter on B19.
The three of you enter the elevator and head to B4.
You try to select floors below B7 on your way down, but they are indeed locked.
Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory343.jpg
Emergency Stairwell
Between B9 and B10
You have not seen many Hetero-Creatures on your way, but you have encountered protective barriers in the stairwell on each floor.
Lucia has been tearing down these barriers, so you are able to descend steadily.
You keep going until you see a large "B10" written on the wall, where Ishmael stops.
Ishmael
It seems we'll have to part ways here for now, Gray Raven Commandant.
...Because of your mission?
Ishmael
Correct. My data says the Dark Room's control room is on B10.
Can you handle the Hetero-Creatures?
Ishmael says nothing, just giving you that enigmatic smile of hers.
You remember that line in your mission briefing—you are "not responsible for the safety of the accompanying Control Court member".
Ishmael
Don't worry... I can handle myself in a fight.
Get down!
Right as you are talking, a Hetero-Creature sneaks up from behind Ishmael.
Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryWhite.prefab
Ishmael does not look back—she just takes a step to the left, dodging the Hetero-Creature's claws.
In one move, she pulls out a pistol, turns, and fires—the bullet heading straight toward the Hetero-Creature's head.
Ishmael's smile has not shifted a bit.
Ishmael
I'm a Construct, after all—my computing power can help me dodge a few attacks.
Ishmael
Hmm... Just like that.
The Hetero-Creature hits the ground with a thud.
Ishmael
Also, I can try to take back control of the "Dark Room's" defense system from the control room.
Ishmael
Maybe I can even crack the sealed defense system... Who knows?
